scope.summary: Replace the split seat plank and re-secure the loose armrest on the public park bench.
tasks: Measure the seat plank and armrest mounting points
Remove the damaged plank and exposed fasteners
Fit and fix a replacement plank with rounded edges
Tighten or replace the loose armrest bracket
Clean the work area and remove debris
